title_original: The Distance Between Being There and Being Seen at La Biennale di Venezia
editorial_title_zh: 在威尼斯双年展：到场与被看见之间的距离
editorial_excerpt_zh: 仅仅受邀进入房间，并不意味着你能决定自己站在哪里。Suzette Bell-Roberts，2026年10月8日。在威尼斯双年展，可见性自有其地理格局，并非每个国家都能以同等条件进入其中。
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "heading", "text": "仅仅受邀进入房间，并不意味着你能决定自己站在哪里。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在威尼斯双年展，可见性自有其地理格局，并非每个国家都能以同等条件进入其中。对于非洲及全球非洲侨民国家馆而言，问题不只是有谁到场，更是谁能被看见、他们如何被看见，以及是什么造成了这种差别。塞内加尔馆。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IMG_9214-773x1030.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "塞内加尔馆。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "credit": "ART AFRICA", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在威尼斯双年展，有些国家享有被人发现的便利；另一些国家则必须说服你去寻找它们。走过绿园城堡（Giardini）和军械库（Arsenale），一个个国家馆相继出现，把参观者带到他们原本或许无意接触的艺术家和艺术史面前。离开这些场地后，被发现就不再那么有保障。有些国家馆仍位于参观者自然会经过的路线上，另一些则需要人们有意识地决定去寻找。由此形成了一套注意力等级：有些国家受益于路过的访客，另一些则依赖那些已经有所了解、会主动找上门的参观者。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "对于那些艺术家与艺术史长期被西方主导的艺术史叙事边缘化的国家，这一点至关重要。威尼斯提供了纠正这种失衡、让新观众接触这些国家自身历史的机会。然而，仅仅参展并不能保证人们会走进它们的国家馆，也不能保证其艺术家会得到真正有意义的关注，更不能保证更高的可见度会在双年展结束后延续。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "可见性的地理格局由此开始。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "2026年，共有100个国家参展：29个在绿园城堡，25个在军械库，46个分布于威尼斯其他地点。7个国家首次参展，其中4个来自非洲：几内亚、赤道几内亚、塞拉利昂和索马里。尽管这些国家拥有同等的官方地位，它们在可达性、关注度与代表性方面的处境却各不相同。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "埃及馆由Armen Agop创作的《Silence Pavilion: Between the Tangible and the Intangible》，以及巴西馆由Rosana Paulino和Adriana Varejão创作的《Comigo ninguém pode》，都设于绿园城堡的永久展馆；摩洛哥馆由Amina Agueznay创作的《Asǝṭṭa》则位于军械库。南非在军械库也有一处长期使用的展馆，尽管该国今年没有参展。这些地点处于双年展注意力原本就高度集中的路线上，参观者无需特意寻找，便会遇见这些国家馆。没有永久场地的国家则面临另一种挑战：它们必须在威尼斯其他地方建立自己的存在，并吸引参观者前往一个可能每次参展都会更换的地点。永久展馆还会随着时间积累熟悉感，成为回访者已知地理格局的一部分；在不同场地之间迁移的国家，则每次都必须在新地点重新让人们看见自己。埃及艺术家Armen Agop在埃及馆外。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IMG_9493-773x1030.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "埃及艺术家Armen Agop在埃及馆外。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "credit": "ART AFRICA", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "国家馆设在绿园城堡或军械库之外，并不一定意味着它处于边缘。塞内加尔馆《WURUS》和乌干达馆《Kampala》位于相邻场地，就在Riva degli Schiavoni沿岸。古巴馆《Hombres Libres / Free Men》位于Via Garibaldi，也处在通往绿园城堡和军械库的主要步行路线上的相似位置。刚果民主共和国首个国家馆《Simba Moto! Seize the Fire! Saisis le feu!》也便利地坐落在Castello一处繁忙的广场上。这些国家馆都位于双年展观众很可能经过的路线上，因此人们无需特意寻找也能看到它们。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "几内亚首次国家参展项目《Le Son de l’Art: l’Écho de la Matière》所处的地理环境截然不同。它位于圣塞尔沃洛岛，无法仅靠拐进威尼斯的另一条街道抵达。参观者必须主动决定前往，留出路途时间，并购买水上巴士船票；参观这个国家馆本身因此成了一趟专程出行。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "单看距离近，也可能产生误导。埃塞俄比亚展览《Shapes of Silence》由Tegene Kunbi创作、Abebaw Ayalew策展；津巴布韦展览《Second Nature | Manyonga》由Fadzai Veronica Muchemwa策展。两者都在Castello举办，邻近绿园城堡、军械库以及塞内加尔馆和乌干达馆。然而，寻找它们的过程表明，仅仅几米之内，可见性就可能轻易改变。Riva degli Schiavoni上的双年展官方指示牌将参观者引入一条通往埃塞俄比亚馆和津巴布韦馆的小巷；但到了路线分岔处，只有埃塞俄比亚馆得到清楚标示。我们本来就计划参观这两个馆，却仍很难找到津巴布韦馆。在地图上，两者的差异微乎其微；实际步行时，少了一块标牌，就让其中一个馆比另一个馆容易找到得多。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "资金同样塑造着可见性。没有永久展馆的国家必须租用临时场地，往往要在双年展开幕很久之前就落实。因此，预算规模和资金到位时间会决定还有哪些空间可供选择。资金既会影响能把何种艺术带到威尼斯并加以展出，也会影响传播资源，以及艺术家和策展人能否在至关重要的开幕日到场。它的后果随处可见：国家馆设在哪里，观众抵达后会看到什么，谁会在现场讲解作品，以及展览能在多大程度上吸引门外的注意。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "ART AFRICA亲身经历了这种后果。我们专程来到威尼斯，报道非洲及全球非洲侨民国家馆，却没有收到海地、坦桑尼亚、乌干达、几内亚或新几内亚方面的任何联络：没有新闻稿，没有邀请，也没有人来接洽采访安排。随后，我们多次给威尼斯双年展官方新闻材料中列出的这些国家馆媒体联系人发送电子邮件，却没有收到回复；几个月后，我们仍未得到任何消息。古巴馆。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IMG_9400-2-773x1030.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "古巴馆。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "credit": "ART AFRICA", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "我们无从知道原因，这也不意味着这些国家馆没有在其他地方得到宣传。然而，如果主动寻求报道它们的专业媒体都无法通过所提供的官方渠道取得联系，它们又能多有效地触达那些原本并不知道其存在的观众？", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "然而，可见性只是问题的一部分。找到一个国家馆之后，另一个问题仍然存在：谁被选来代表这个国家，谁作出了这些选择，人们看到的又是这个国家的哪一种版本？塞拉利昂、几内亚、索马里和赤道几内亚都是首次参展，这些国家馆使上述问题格外突出。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "塞拉利昂首次参展，让这个问题尤其值得关注。由意大利人Sandro Orlandi Stagl和Willy Montini策展的《Mondi Presenti / Worlds of Today》汇集了16位艺术家：4位来自塞拉利昂，4位来自西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）的其他成员国——塞内加尔、多哥、贝宁和尼日利亚——7位来自意大利，1位来自墨西哥。策展陈述把该馆置于ECOWAS的语境中，同时提及非洲与意大利之间的交流史。因此，纳入来自西非邻国的艺术家，显然与这一框架有关。较难理解的是，为何7位意大利艺术家占据了塞拉利昂首次国家展示近一半的名额，墨西哥艺术家如何融入策展概念，以及归根结底，是谁决定哪一种塞拉利昂版本会进入双年展的官方记录。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "几内亚的首展《Le Son de l’Art: l’Écho de la Matière》由意大利策展人Carlo Stragapede策划，把问题进一步推向紧要处。展览汇集了约66位艺术家，其中包括相当数量的意大利人，而似乎只有很少一部分是几内亚人。问题不只是选了谁，更在于这些选择以什么为依据，以及这样一个大型国际展览如何在几内亚首次登上双年展国家平台时代表这个国家。以几内亚之名呈现的，究竟是谁对这个国家及其当代文化社群的理解？", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "同样首次参展的赤道几内亚馆《The Forest The Undergrowth》由加泰罗尼亚策展人Joan Abelló策划，让这个问题变得更加直白。23名参展者包括来自意大利、西班牙、中国、罗马尼亚、芬兰、阿尔巴尼亚、喀麦隆、塞浦路斯、德国和以色列的艺术家，而可明确识别为赤道几内亚艺术家的只有Fernando Nguema Madja一人。国家馆还纳入了出生于加泰罗尼亚、曾在赤道几内亚生活和工作的Modest Gené Roig。在这里，代表性问题已经遭到该国文化社群内部的质疑。双年展开幕前，一群赤道几内亚文化工作者公开指出，该国当代声音大多缺席，并呼吁让本地艺术家和文化专业人士参与策展过程。绿园城堡。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IMG_9907-1003x1030.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "绿园城堡。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "credit": "ART AFRICA", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "索马里首次国家参展，引发了一场更加直接的争论：谁有资格在威尼斯代表一个国家？《SADDEXLEEY》展出Ayan Farah、Asmaa Jama和Warsan Shire的作品，由常驻斯德哥尔摩的Mohamed Mire与意大利项目经理Fabio Scrivanti共同策展。索马里艺术基金会公开批评该馆，称其没有与常驻索马里的艺术家和艺术机构进行有实质意义的协商；索马里团体Warbixinta Cidda则要求撤换Scrivanti，并鉴于意大利在索马里的殖民史，质疑为何任命一名意大利人担任联合策展人。随后，一封公开信援引了两方声明，并表示若诉求得不到回应，将呼吁抵制该馆。这场争议为代表性问题增添了另一个维度：问题不只是选中了哪些艺术家，还包括咨询了谁，谁参与作出这些决定，以及最终以这个国家之名呈现的是谁对它的理解。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "综合来看，这四个首次设立的国家馆引出了一个更广泛的策展权威问题。问题不在于策展人的国籍，也不是说非洲国家馆必须由本国或本洲人士策展。关键在于谁有权代表一个国家，哪些知识和关系构成其选择的依据，该国艺术家与文化工作者如何参与这一过程，以及最终由谁决定什么会以这个国家的名义被人看见。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这些问题并不新鲜。2013年的肯尼亚馆由两名意大利人策展，参展者包括8位中国艺术家、1位意大利艺术家和2位肯尼亚艺术家。2015年，人们再次对该国如何被代表提出类似忧虑，肯尼亚艺术家表示反对，政府随后撤回支持。2022年的首个纳米比亚馆《A Bridge to the Desert》也招致类似批评。展览由意大利人Marco Furio Ferrario策划，展出匿名艺术家RENN的作品；纳米比亚艺术界对该国如何被代表提出异议，纳米比亚政府随后撤回支持，但展览仍然举行。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这些争议表明，官方参展与文化正当性之间存在差别。一个国家馆让人看见的不只是某个国家，也是对这个国家的一种特定呈现；因此，谁有权构建这种呈现，与这个国家究竟有没有被看见同样重要。巴哈马馆，装置现场。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IMG_9169-1030x773.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "巴哈马馆，装置现场。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供。", "credit": "ART AFRICA", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "可见性也受到汇聚于威尼斯的专业网络影响，开幕周尤其如此。博物馆馆长、策展人、收藏家、基金会、画廊和媒体会在几天紧凑的时间里停留于此；与艺术家、策展人或机构已有联系，可以帮助一个国家馆成为人们专程前往的目的地，而缺少这种关系的国家馆，则更依赖于在现有网络之外争取关注。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "对于记者而言，由于时间有限、威尼斯花费高昂，那几天往往是他们在当地采访艺术家和策展人的唯一机会。争夺注意力的活动如此之多——包括绿园城堡、军械库、100个国家参展项目、平行活动以及各种展览——更难找到的国家馆必须投入额外的时间和精力。此外，地理位置与专业网络还会相互作用：偏离主要路线的国家馆，必须付出更多努力，才能进入专业关注流动的渠道。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "然而，一个国家馆的观众并不限于走进展馆大门的人。媒体报道可以把展览带到威尼斯之外很远的地方，触达永远不会亲临双年展的读者和观众。评论、采访、照片、视频、播客、通讯和专业出版物，可以把艺术家及其作品介绍给全新的观众；一次采访也可能让某位从未在威尼斯看过展览的策展人注意到一位艺术家。这些报道还让国家馆在双年展的数月展期之外继续存在，形成一份即使展览结束很久后仍可流传的记录。从这个意义上说，国家馆之外发生的事，可能变得和馆内发生的事同样重要。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "国际媒体报道未必比全国性、地区性或专业报道更有价值；后几类报道能够提供综合性报道往往忽略的背景和语境。真正重要的是报道能传播多远，是否把艺术家及其作品介绍给原本不熟悉他们的人，以及这份关注能否在威尼斯之外产生任何结果。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "高度可见，并不一定意味着具有真正的影响。图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://artafricamagazine.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IMG_9219-2-773x1030.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "图片由Brendon Bell-Roberts提供", "credit": "ART AFRICA", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在思考各国为何选择投资威尼斯时，这一点很重要，因为参展需要投入大量资金和机构资源，因此参观人数众多未必说明这笔投入物有所值。一个挤满观众的国家馆或许能获得一定曝光，却不一定取得任何实际成果；较少的互动反而可能促成展览、收藏、委托创作、出版，或建立长期的机构关系。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "没有任何单一标准可以评判成功，因为本来就不该只有一个标准。然而，单凭参展也无法衡量成功。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "如果国际曝光是参加双年展的一个理由，那么国家馆开幕后便会出现更具实质意义的问题。它是否让原本不熟悉这些艺术家及其各自艺术史的人注意到他们？是否有人在其他机构语境中撰文介绍、采访或展出他们的作品？艺术家是否获得了新机会？是否有任何关系在离开威尼斯后仍延续下来？", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因此，可见性的地理层面延伸到了威尼斯之外：它影响被发现的机会，引导专业关注，塑造与一个国家之名相联系的内容，并影响这种国家呈现此后能够延伸多远。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "对于非洲国家及全球非洲侨民而言，个中利害尤其重大。威尼斯双年展可以让那些长期被西方主导的叙事边缘化的艺术家与艺术史得到更广泛的关注，为他们打开通往原本可能遥不可及的观众、机构和对话的大门。然而，在双年展中拥有一个官方席位，并不能保证获得同等的被发现机会，也不一定会让艺术家和文化社群对于本国及本国历史如何被呈现拥有更大的决定权。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这些差别早在大门开启之前便已出现，也可能在闭门很久之后继续存在。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "因此，到场只是开始。如果原本没有人在寻找你，威尼斯是否让他们开始寻找——而当他们真正看过来时，又是谁决定了他们会看见什么？", "translated": true}]

article_text:
Just because you are invited into the room does not mean you decide where you stand.

At La Biennale di Venezia, visibility has its own geography, and not every country enters it on equal terms. For African and global African diaspora pavilions, the question is not simply who is present, but who gets seen, how they are seen, and what determines the difference. The Senegalese Pavilion. Image courtesy of Brendon Bell-Roberts

At La Biennale di Venezia, some countries have the privilege of being discovered; others have to persuade you to look for them. Walk through the Giardini and the Arsenale and national pavilions appear one after another, introducing visitors to artists and art histories they may never have intended to see. Beyond these venues, discovery becomes less assured. Some pavilions remain on routes visitors naturally take, while others require a conscious decision to find them. This creates a hierarchy of attention: some countries benefit from passing visitors, while others depend on visitors who already know enough to seek them out.

For countries whose artists and art histories have been marginalised by Western-dominated narratives of art history, this matters. Venice offers an opportunity to challenge that imbalance and bring their own histories to new audiences. But participation alone cannot guarantee that their pavilions will be encountered, that their artists will receive meaningful attention, or that greater visibility will continue beyond the Biennale.

Here, the geography of visibility begins.

In 2026, one hundred countries are taking part: twenty-nine at the Giardini, twenty-five at the Arsenale and forty-six elsewhere in Venice. Seven nations are exhibiting for the first time, four of them from Africa: Guinea, Equatorial Guinea, Sierra Leone and Somalia. Although these countries have the same official status, their situations regarding access, attention, and representation differ.

Egypt’s Silence Pavilion: Between the Tangible and the Intangible , by Armen Agop, and Brazil’s Comigo ninguém pode , by Rosana Paulino and Adriana Varejão, occupy permanent pavilions in the Giardini, while Morocco’s Asǝṭṭa , by Amina Agueznay, is located in the Arsenale. South Africa too has a long-term presence at the Arsenale, even though it did not take part this year. These locations sit within the routes where Biennale attention is already concentrated, allowing visitors to encounter the pavilions without deliberately seeking them out. Countries without permanent sites face a different challenge: they must establish their presence elsewhere in Venice and attract visitors to a location that may change with each participation. Permanent pavilions also acquire familiarity over time, becoming part of the geography returning visitors already know, while countries that move between venues must make themselves visible in a new place each time. Egyptian artist Armen Agop outside the Egyptian Pavilion. Image courtesy of Brendon Bell-Roberts

A pavilion situated outside the Giardini or the Arsenale doesn’t necessarily mean it is peripheral. Senegal’s WURUS and Uganda’s Kampala are in adjacent locations right on the Riva degli Schiavoni. Cuba’s Hombres Libres / Free Men , which is on Via Garibaldi, is also in a similar position along the main pedestrian route leading to the Giardini and the Arsenale. The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s first pavilion, Simba Moto! Seize the Fire! Saisis le feu!, is also conveniently located on a busy square in Castello. These pavilions sit along paths Biennale visitors are likely to follow and can therefore see without having to look for them specifically.

Guinea’s first National Participation, Le Son de l’Art: l’Écho de la Matière , occupies a very different geography. Located on the island of San Servolo, it cannot be reached simply by turning down another Venetian street. Visitors have to decide to go there, allow time for the journey and pay for a vaporetto, turning a pavilion visit into a destination in itself.

Mere proximity can also be misleading. The exhibitions Ethiopia’s Shapes of Silence , by Tegene Kunbi and curated by Abebaw Ayalew, and Zimbabwe’s Second Nature | Manyonga , curated by Fadzai Veronica Muchemwa, were both held at Castello, near the Giardini, Arsenale, Senegal, and Uganda. Yet finding them revealed how easily visibility can change within a few metres. Official Biennale signage on the Riva degli Schiavoni directed visitors down the alley towards both Ethiopia and Zimbabwe, but where the route divided, only Ethiopia was clearly signposted. We had deliberately set out to visit both and still struggled to find Zimbabwe. On a map, the difference was negligible; on foot, a missing sign made one pavilion considerably easier to find than the other.

Financial resources also shape visibility. Countries without permanent pavilions must secure temporary venues, often long before the Biennale opens, so budget size and timing can determine which spaces remain available. Funding can influence the kind of art that can be brought to Venice and exhibited, as well as the resources available for communications and for artists and curators to be present during the crucial opening days. The consequences are visible throughout: in where a pavilion is located, what audiences encounter when they arrive, who is there to speak about the work and how effectively the exhibition attracts attention beyond its doors.

ART AFRICA encountered the consequences firsthand. We were in Venice specifically to report on the African and global African diaspora pavilions, yet received no communication from Haiti, Tanzania, Uganda, Guinea, or New Guinea: no press releases, invitations, or approaches to arrange interviews. We then repeatedly emailed the media contacts listed for these pavilions in the official press material from La Biennale di Venezia, but received no response and, months later, still have not heard from them. The Cuban Pavilion. Image courtesy of Brendon Bell-Roberts

We cannot know why, nor does this mean that these pavilions received no publicity elsewhere. But if specialist media actively seeking to cover them could not make contact through the official channels provided, how effectively were they reaching audiences who did not already know they were there?

But visibility is only one part of the question. Once a pavilion has been found, another issue remains: who has been chosen to represent the country, who made those choices, and what version of the country is being made visible? Sierra Leone, Guinea, Somalia and Equatorial Guinea, all participating for the first time, bring these questions into sharp focus.

Sierra Leone’s first participation makes this question particularly relevant. Mondi Presenti / Worlds of Today , curated by Italians Sandro Orlandi Stagl and Willy Montini, brings together sixteen artists: four from Sierra Leone, four from other ECOWAS countries (the Economic Community of West African States)—Senegal, Togo, Benin, and Nigeria—seven from Italy, and one from Mexico. The curatorial statement places the pavilion within the context of ECOWAS while also referring to a history of exchange between Africa and Italy. The inclusion of artists from neighbouring West African countries therefore clearly relates to that framework. Less clear is why seven Italian artists make up almost half of Sierra Leone’s first national presentation, how the Mexican artist fits within the curatorial concept, and ultimately who determines the version of Sierra Leone that enters the Biennale’s official record.

Guinea’s inaugural Le Son de l’Art: l’Écho de la Matière , curated by Italian curator Carlo Stragapede, raises the stakes further. The exhibition brings together roughly 66 artists, including a significant number of Italians, while only a small minority appear to be Guinean. The issue is not simply who was selected, but what informed those choices and how such a large international exhibition comes to represent Guinea on its first national platform at the Biennale. Whose understanding of the country and its contemporary cultural community is being presented in its name?

Also participating for the first time, Equatorial Guinea’s The Forest The Undergrowth , curated by Catalan curator Joan Abelló, makes the issue even more explicit. Its 23 exhibitors include artists from Italy, Spain, China, Romania, Finland, Albania, Cameroon, Cyprus, Germany and Israel, alongside only one clearly identified Equatoguinean artist, Fernando Nguema Madja. The pavilion also includes Catalan-born Modest Gené Roig, who lived and worked in Equatorial Guinea. Here the question of representation has already been challenged from within the country’s cultural community. Before the Biennale opened, a group of Equatoguinean cultural practitioners publicly argued that contemporary voices from the country were largely absent and called for local artists and cultural professionals to be included in the curatorial process. The Giardini. Image courtesy of Brendon Bell-Roberts

Somalia’s first National Participation has prompted an even more direct debate over who gets to represent a country in Venice. SADDEXLEEY , featuring Ayan Farah, Asmaa Jama and Warsan Shire, is curated by Stockholm-based Mohamed Mire and Italian project manager Fabio Scrivanti. The Somali Arts Foundation has publicly criticised the pavilion for what it describes as a lack of meaningful consultation with artists and arts organisations based in Somalia, while the Somali collective Warbixinta Cidda has called for Scrivanti’s removal, questioning the appointment of an Italian co-curator given Italy’s colonial history in Somalia. An open letter subsequently drew on both statements and called for a boycott if its demands were not addressed. The dispute adds another dimension to the question of representation: not simply which artists are selected, but who is consulted, who participates in making those decisions and whose understanding of the country is ultimately presented in its name.

Taken together, these four inaugural pavilions raise a broader question of curatorial authority. The issue is not the curator’s nationality, nor must an African national pavilion be curated by someone from that country or continent. What matters is who has the authority to represent a country, what knowledge and relationships inform their choices, how its artists and cultural practitioners participate in that process, and ultimately who determines what becomes visible in the country’s name.

These questions are nothing new; the Kenya pavilion of 2013, curated by two Italians, included eight Chinese artists, one Italian, and two Kenyans. When comparable concerns were raised about the country’s representation in 2015, Kenyan artists objected, and the government then withdrew its support. The first Namibian pavilion in 2022, A Bridge to the Desert , also attracted similar criticism. Curated by Italian Marco Furio Ferrario and featuring the anonymous artist RENN, this exhibition drew objections from Namibia’s arts community over the country’s representation; the Namibian government subsequently withdrew its support, although the exhibition took place.

The controversies showed the difference between official participation and cultural legitimacy; a national pavilion makes visible not only a country but a specific representation of it, so it matters as much who has the authority to construct that representation as it does that the country is seen at all. The Bahamas Pavilion, installation view. Image courtesy of Brendon Bell-Roberts.

Visibility is also influenced by the professional networks that come together in Venice, particularly during the opening week, when museum directors, curators, collectors, foundations, galleries, and the press stay for a few intense days; having an established relationship with an artist, a curator, or an institution can help make a pavilion into a destination, while those who do not have such connections depend more on drawing attention outside of their current networks.

For journalists, those few days are often the only chance to interview artists and curators while in Venice, since time is limited and the city is expensive. So many events compete for attention—namely the Giardini, the Arsenale, the 100 National Participations, the collateral events, and the various exhibitions—that harder-to-find pavilions must put in extra time and effort. Moreover, geography and professional networks can interact: a pavilion off the main routes must work harder to enter the channels through which professional attention flows.

Yet a pavilion’s audience is not limited to the people who walk through its doors. Media coverage can take an exhibition far beyond Venice, reaching readers and viewers who will never attend the Biennale. Reviews, interviews, photographs, videos, podcasts, newsletters and specialist publications can introduce artists and their work to entirely new audiences, while an interview might bring an artist to the attention of a curator who never saw the exhibition in Venice. This coverage also gives the pavilion life beyond the months of the Biennale, creating a record that can circulate long after the exhibition has closed. In this sense, what happens beyond the pavilion can become as important as what happens inside it.

International media coverage is not necessarily more valuable than national, regional, or specialist coverage, which can offer the backgrounds and contexts that general reporting tends to ignore. What matters is how far the coverage reaches, whether it introduces the artists and their work to people who were not already familiar with them, and whether the attention results in anything beyond Venice.

Being highly visible doesn’t necessarily mean having a real impact. Image courtesy of Brendon Bell-Roberts

It is important when considering the reasons why countries choose to invest in Venice, since taking part requires a great deal of financial and institutional resources and therefore high numbers of visitors do not necessarily indicate that the investment has been worthwhile; a pavilion that is crowded may bring about some degree of exposure without achieving any real results, while fewer interactions could result in exhibitions, acquisitions, commissions, publications, or in the establishment of long-term institutional relationships.

No single criterion can judge success, since there shouldn’t be one. However, participation alone cannot measure success.

If international exposure is one reason for taking part in the Biennale, then more significant questions arise once the pavilion has opened. Has it brought the artists and their respective art histories to the attention of people who are not already familiar with them? Has anyone written about, interviewed, or exhibited their work in other institutional contexts? Have the artists obtained new opportunities? Have any relationships persisted after Venice?

The geographical aspect of visibility therefore extends beyond Venice; it affects the chances of discovery, directs professional interest, shapes the kind of content linked to a country’s name, and influences how far that representation will extend afterwards.

For African countries and the global African diaspora, the stakes are particularly high. La Biennale di Venezia can bring artists and art histories long marginalised by Western-dominated narratives to wider attention, opening doors to audiences, institutions and conversations that might otherwise remain out of reach. But an official place within the Biennale does not guarantee an equal chance of being discovered, nor does it necessarily give artists and cultural communities greater authority over how their countries and histories are presented.

The differences begin long before the doors open and can continue long after they close.

Presence, then, is only the beginning. If nobody was looking for you, did Venice make them look — and when they did, who decided what they would see?

article_text:
EXCLUSIVE: Rick Cosnett , Richard Kind and Tammy Blanchard are the latest confirmed cast for grief-themed indie The Long Run . They join previously announced Alice Eve in the film, directed by Harold Cronk ( Unbroken: Path to Redemption ).

The character-driven film revolves around a woman named Claire (Eve) who made a promise to her husband, Ben, that they would one day run the Marine Corps Marathon together. After Ben is killed in an overseas explosion, Claire is left numbed by grief and becomes a single mother. To honor his memory, she decides to run the 26.2-mile marathon alone, guided by the weight of her grief and love. Eve’s Claire rediscovers life thanks to the unruly rescue dog her husband left behind — an unlikely companion who pulls her, mile by mile, toward the marathon they once promised to run together and a deeper connection with her young son.

Related Stories

Alice Eve Inks With Verve, Boards 'The Long Run'

'The Rainmaker' Boss Teases Season 2 As First-Look Photos Of Merle Dandridge, Richard Kind & Returning Cast Drop

Cosnett plays Ben, Kind portrays Walter and Blanchard is Vanessa.

Watch on Deadline

Production is currently underway in Louisville, KY.

Cronk directs from a screenplay by Liz Larsen and Brando Colonna. Leeni Marshall is producing for Rare Films.

Cosnett most recently appeared in Palm Royale, Doctor Odyssey and 9-1-1 and next will be seen in a guest role in Your Friends & Neighbors . Cosnett is repped by Innovative Artists and Bob McGowan at McGowan Rodriguez Management.

Kind most recently starred in indie comedy Not Dead Yet , alongside Polly Draper, Paul Raci, Tovah Feldshuh, Bill Smitrovich and Ed German. He’ll next be seen starring in dark comedic thriller Jacob and the Wolf, starring Sam Lerner, Camille Hyde and Nikola Djuricko. Kind is repped by Innovative Artists and Forster Entertainment.

Emmy winner Blanchard is in post on three films, horror Cabbage , Bella Thorne’s directorial debut Color Your Hurt and in indie legal drama Henry. She’s repped by

Cronk is repped by Ryan Saul at Evoke Entertainment and attorney Larry Weinberg.

Matt Grobar contributed to this report.

article_text:
CREATIVE CLASS PHOTO EXHIBITION「CCPE」が、2026年9月25日から27日まで東京・杉並のstudio behind by sceneryで開催される。

「CCPE」は、デジタルクリエイティブ領域で活躍するクリエイターから直接フィードバックを受けられるオンラインスクール「CREATIVE CLASS supported by iDID」のフォトディレクションコースから生まれた初の合同写真展。同コースでは、写真家／ビジュアルディレクターのshuntaroがマスターを務めている。

今回参加するのは、アルファ／Alfa、Chiharu Kodama、Nenpa_、Syuheiinoue、木村洋達、トム・イシカワ、中村和貴、間宮真介の8名。会場となるのは、shuntaro率いるクリエイティブスタジオbird and insectの撮影スタジオ、studio behind by sceneryだ。

展覧会の中心となるのは、受講生それぞれが企画から装丁まで一貫して制作したオリジナル写真集。完成した写真を壁面に並べるだけでなく、一冊の本として写真を編集し、ストーリーを構築するところまでを作品として提示する。来場者は実際に写真集を手に取って閲覧できる。

さらに、それぞれの写真集が持つ世界観を会場空間へと展開。セレクトされた写真のパネル展示も行い、本という二次元のメディアと展示空間を往来しながら作品を体験できる構成となる。会場ではオリジナルグッズや写真集の販売も予定している。

タイトル

CREATIVE CLASS PHOTO EXHIBITION「CCPE」

場所

studio behind by scenery（東京都杉並区下高井戸4-1-20）

会期

2026年9月25日（金）～27日（日）

時間

9月25日（金）18:00～20:00（オープニングレセプション）、9月26日（土）・27日（日）11:00～17:00

休み

無し

料金

無料

URL

https://ccpe.jp/

article_text:
【次回のＥテレ・日曜美術館】

＜朝＞

今年開創700年を迎える大徳寺。通常非公開の名宝の数々が東京国立博物館に集結しています。東洋絵画の最高峰といわれる国宝「観音猿鶴図」に表された“見えない音の世界”とは？一休宗純の気迫の墨 蹟 「七仏通戒偈」を書道家の武田双雲さんが分析します。そのほか、現代の妖怪漫画にも影響を与えた「百鬼夜行絵巻」や、奇跡の茶碗「曜変天目」など、大徳寺の至宝を堪能します。

司会: 坂本美雨,守本奈実 出演: 武田双雲

◇あわせて読みたい

＜夜＞

世界最古の長編小説ともいわれる「源氏物語」を紫式部が書いてから千年。なぜ日本人はずっとこの物語を愛し続けてきたのでしょうか。平安時代の国宝「源氏物語絵巻」をはじめ、室町時代の能「葵上」、江戸時代の国宝「 関屋澪標図 屏風」や海外から里帰りした黄金の「幻の絵巻」など、それぞれの時代の美意識が作り上げた多様な美の世界が京都に集結。令和版現代語訳を手がけた角田光代さんとともに、源氏物語千年愛の軌跡を追います。

司会: 坂本美雨,守本奈実 出演: 角田光代,山本淳子,井並林太郎,山内麻衣子,土屋貴裕,松岡知華

◇あわせて読みたい

（読売新聞美術展ナビ編集班）

article_text:
News

Rembrandt’s Ancient Obsessions Are Made Anew in Upcoming Met Exhibition

Co-organized with the Louvre, "Rembrandt and the Ancients" opens at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in November 2027 and will travel to Paris in 2028.

The Metropolitan Museum of Art in Manhattan and the Musée du Louvre in Paris have joined forces to co-organize a major exhibition exploring Greco-Roman and biblical influences throughout Rembrandt's practice. As the first comprehensive presentation of Rembrandt at The Met in over 20 years, Rembrandt and the Ancients is set to open in November 2027 and will display multiple works by the Dutch master in the United States for the first time.

Assembled from both institutions' collections and a variety of international loans, the exhibition brings together over 125 objects, including Rembrandt's paintings, drawings, and prints, along with a selection of influential historic reference materials.

Rembrandt's career took shape amid a prolific period of antiquities collecting during the Dutch Golden Age, as multiple high-profile merchants and collectors, including the Reijnst brothers, Johannes Smetius, and Franciscus Junius, developed extensive holdings of Ancient Greco-Roman and Renaissance-era artifacts, texts, and archaeological objects. The relatively recent invention of the printing press also enabled the mass distribution of classical, philosophical, and scientific texts translated into Dutch.
excerpt_original: Co-organized with the Louvre, "Rembrandt and the Ancients" opens at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in November 2027 and will travel to Paris in 2028.

article_text:
小栗ゆかりの地に熱心なファン詰めかける

来年の大河ドラマのスタートに向けたイベント「大河ドラマ『逆賊の幕臣』プレリュードin高崎」が10月31日、群馬県高崎市の高崎芸術劇場で開かれました。高崎は2027年の大河ドラマ「逆賊の幕臣」の主人公、小栗 忠順 が慶応4年（1868）にその人生を終えたゆかりの地です。この日のイベントには11,500通もの応募があり、およそ10倍の倍率を突破した熱心なファンが会場に詰め掛けました。

トークショーにはキャストの上白石萌音さん、青木崇高さん、草川拓弥さん、甲本雅裕さんと、スタッフから勝田夏子制作統括が登壇。

「不器用で愛らしい夫です」と上白石さん

小栗忠順（松坂桃李さん）の妻、みち役を演じる上白石萌音さんは「家の外では切れ者の夫ですが、家ではリラックスしてて、不器用で愛らしい姿を身近で見ることができて幸せです。みちは学問好きで、記録を取ることも好きなオタク気質で、似た者夫婦です」と役柄を説明。また、社会科教師をしている上白石さんの父親は小栗忠順を研究テーマにするほど敬愛しており、「今回のキャスティングのオファーがあった時は、『これはやりなさい！お願いだから受けてほしい』と言われました」と親子の会話を打ち明け、場内は笑いに包まれました。

勝った側「じゃない」方の歴史を語る意義

勝田制作統括は、「幕末と言うと勝者側の薩長などから語られることが多いですが、今回は『じゃない方』の歴史です」とドラマの枠組みを説明。小栗忠順を主人公にした理由について、「小栗忠順のことは、大河ドラマのテーマを探しているときに初めて知りました。知ってしまうと、『なぜ今まで知らなかったのか』と思うほどの人物でした。現代にも繋がる日本の近代化の礎を築いた人です」とその魅力を語りました。

その上で、勝田制作統括は「科学技術の進んだ欧米の脅威にさらされた幕末の日本と、AIの発達などで未来が見通せない私たちの現代は、とても似ていると感じています。だからこそ幕末に新たな道を切り拓こうと奮闘した人々を紹介したいと思いました」とドラマの狙いを語りました。

小栗忠順のお墓参りも

出演者は高崎来訪に合わせて、高崎市郊外にある小栗忠順らの墓や、功績を顕彰する胸像などに手を合わせました。

大河ドラマ「逆賊の幕臣」は1月10日（日）のスタートです。またこの日のイベントのハイライトは以下の番組で放送予定。群馬県外からは「NHK ONE」で視聴可能です。 ■ほっとぐんま630【総合・群馬県】11月2日（月）、5日（木）午後6時30分～7時のニュース内 ■ぐんまスペシャル【総合・群馬県】12月18日(金)午後7時30分～7時57分

article_text:
Epsilon Film has acquired worldwide rights to “Apple Cadabra – I Shrunk Myself,” an animated family adventure movie based on “Petronella Applesauce,” one of Germany’s most successful children’s book series.

Epsilon Film will launch international sales on “Apple Cadabra – I Shrunk Myself” at the American Film Market, which runs Nov. 10-15 in Los Angeles, where buyers will get a first look at footage from the movie.

Related Stories

Why Netflix, Amazon and Other Streamers Have Not Proved Saviors for the Kids Content Industry

Why Netflix Fired Dan Lin

“Apple Cadabra – I Shrunk Myself,” which is produced by the team behind “The Elfkins” and “Rabbit Academy,” centers on two children who are magically shrunk into a miniature world.

Popular on Variety

“Blending fantasy, humor, suspense and adventure with an emotional story about empathy and overcoming prejudice, ‘Apple Cadabra – I Shrunk Myself’ brings the beloved literary franchise to the big screen in a magical family adventure with international appeal,” said Epsilon Film in a statement.

Alice von Einem, managing director of Epsilon Film, said, “What immediately captured our imagination was the idea of two children suddenly finding themselves shrunk into Petronella’s enchanted garden and experiencing an entirely new world from a tiny perspective. The film combines a highly commercial adventure premise with universal themes of friendship, courage and belonging, making it a wonderful family event for audiences around the world.”

The film is directed by Ute von Münchow-Pohl (“The Elfkins,” “Rabbit Academy”) and Felix Schichl. The screenplay is by Claudio Winter (“The Elfkins,” “Rabbit Academy”) and Seraina Nyikos.

Character design is by Oliver Kurth (“Monster Family 2,” “Grand Prix of Europe”). The producers are Dirk Beinhold and Valentin Greulich for Akkord Film, the animation studio behind “The Elfkins” and “Rabbit Academy.” Co-production partners include Seru Animation (“My Fairy Troublemaker”), PFX (“The Whalesinger”), VAST and JewelLabs Pictures. Tobis Film will distribute the film widely in German theaters.

At AFM , Epsilon Film will be based at Suite No. 334, the Fairmont Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles.

article_text:
News

$160,000 Hans Arp Sculpture Stolen From Art Cologne

“S’élevant (Rising)” (1962) was snatched from Gallery Ludorff's booth on November 8.

German police are seeking answers about the theft of Hans (Jean) Arp's “S’élevant (Rising)” (1962) from Gallery Ludorff's booth at Art Cologne, which went missing from its plinth on the last day of the blue-chip fair on Sunday, November 8, between 4:55pm and 5:10pm.

Since the fair kicked off on November 5, Arp's work had been sitting atop a plinth at the Düsseldorf gallery's booth, sandwiched between two paintings by Ernst Wilhelm Nay. Four employees were at the stand on November 8 and immediately notified the North Rhine-Westphalia State Police upon noticing that the unbolted sculpture, which is valued at €145,000 (~$160,000), had gone missing. As it remains unclear who made off with the 28-centimeter-tall (~11 in) sculpture, police are seeking any information or photographs from visitors or staffers that could aid in the investigation.

Open call apexart Accepting proposals: Oct 1 – 31, 2026

apexart 291 Church St. New York NY 10013, United States

opencalls@apexart.org apexart.org/opencalls.php

apexart invites 500 word idea-based group exhibition proposals for our 2027-28 NYC Open Call from October 1 – October 31, 2026. Five winning proposals will each receive a $10k exhibition budget to become “apexart exhibitions” as part of our 2027-28

exhibition season. Curators, artists, writers, and creative individuals, regardless of experience level or location, are invited to submit a proposal online.

The submission process Proposals should describe a focused, idea-driven, original group exhibition of 3 or more artists. No biographical info, CVs, links, or images will be accepted. The curator/organizer can be included as an additional artist. Submissions cannot exceed 500 words and must be submitted in English. Jurors from approximately 85 countries then review the proposals based on their personal interest, cultural assessment, content and communication of the idea. See examples of winning proposals here.

The selection process Rather than a typical 5-person local panel to review hundreds of ideas, apexart’s crowd-sourced system involves hundreds of jurors from 85 countries, reviewing proposals at their own schedule over one month. The jury is composed of up to 1000+ individuals from a wide variety of professional backgrounds and international locations including students from 20+ participating university classes. Proposals are anonymous and randomized to ensure each submission receives equal consideration, resulting in more than 30,000 votes on about 500 proposals. apexart staff does not influence the results of the jury in any way.

The results Each of the five winning proposals will receive an exhibition budget of $10,000; along with our exhibition brochure, mailed electronically and physically to over 7,000 international recipients; and be part of apexart’s 2027-2028 exhibition season. apexart provides full administrative and logistic support, assisting curators to realize their original ideas into apexart exhibitions. Exhibition curators must work within the funding provided to transform their winning proposals into focused, noteworthy exhibitions.

To submit an exhibition proposal, visit https://apexart.org/opencalls.php between October 1 and October 31, 2026.

article_text:
Netflix , ‘Elite’ star Ester Expósito and Locarno Winner Mar Coll are adapting Clarín’s classic novel into a feature film which went into production Oct. 23, produced by María Zamora at Elastica Films (“Alcarràs” “Romería”).

Bombshell news – nothing was known of the movie until Friday’s announcement – “La Regenta” now weighs in as one of Spain’s biggest movies of 2027.

Related Stories

Mediawan's Pierre-Antoine Capton on Buying Reese Witherspoon’s Hello Sunshine and Doubling Down on Hollywood Amid Consolidation (EXCLUSIVE)

Toon2Tango to Lead Global Licensing and Merchandising for Mediawan Kids & Family Slate, Including Titles Like ‘Astro Boy’ Reboot (EXCLUSIVE)

Lambasted in its day, Clarín’s “La Regenta” is now acclaimed as a masterpiece, second only to “The Quixote” in Spain, “one of the great novels of the 19th century, alongside ‘Madame Bovary’ and ‘Anna Karenina,’” English writer Julian Barnes said this week.

The current adaptation will be a new contemporary version that reinterprets the classic from a “fresh female perspective,” Netflix announced Friday.

“La Regenta” marks Netflix’s latest venture into revered big literary IP in the Spanish-speaking world after adaptations of Gabriel García Márquez’s “One Hundred Years of Solitude” on Colombia and “The Eternaut” in Argentina. Both were Netflix Global Top 10 non-English hits and signature shows for the U.S. streaming giant.

Published over 1884-85, “La Regenta” turns on Ana Ozores, young, beautiful and married off to Victor Quintanar, a man twice her age and ex magistrate of Vetusta, a sleepy stifling provincial city where, says Netflix “everything is known and everything is judged.”

Seeking sense to her loveless existence, at least in the novel Ana attracts the predatorial lust of Magistral Fermín de Pas, her sensual confessor at La Vetusta cathedral, as well as the attentions of local Don Juan Álvaro Mejías.

“What begins as a private crisis becomes a silent struggle between desire, faith and social power, where Ana’s every move is watched, judged and used by those around her,” the synopsis ends.

Besides Expósito “La Regenta” is fronted by International Emmy Award winner Oriol Pla (“I, Addict,” “The Day After Tomorrow”) as Magistral Fermín de Pas, Vito Sanz (“Billionaires’ Bunker”) as Victor Quintanar and Borja Luna (“Breathless,” “No Traces”) as Álvaro Mesía,

The film big cast also features Clara Ingold (“Iron Reign”) as Petra, Carlos González (“La Bola Negra”) as Frígilis, Ana Torrent (“Thesis”) as Doña Paula, Itsaso Arana (“The Other Way Around,”) as Visitación, and Gonzalo de Castro (“The Inmortal”) as Ripamilán,

Clarín’s monumental, nearly 700-page novel mixes a searing portrait of a backward, hypocritical and vulgar provincial Spain; a vision of toxic masculine egotism; with a deep dive into the psychology and contradictions of its two central characters, Ana and Fermín de Pas.

“La Regenta” the film is written by Coll, Anna R. Costa, co-scribe of series standout “Madrid Arde” and the Barcelona-based Diego Vega, one of Peru’s top auteurs (“October,” “My Lucky Day”).

Coll on ‘La Regenta’

“Clarín’s novel is so rich that dozens of different adaptations can be made from it, like those that came before ours or those that will follow it,” said Coll.

“I have tried to approach the material, humbly, from a radically personal perspective, as I always do,” she added. “I have made my own what has moved me most in the novel, and what explores the loneliness and heartbreak of this regent’s wife, who tirelessly longs to give meaning to her life. A luminous character inhabiting a universe poised to prey on her. A woman whose sensitivity and stubborn search constitute, in themselves, a form of resistance.”

As an adaptation, “La Regenta” fits Coll like a glove. A founding mother of the Newest Catalan Cinema and cultured dissident as Clarion before her, Mar Coll, throughout a now 20-year career, has consistently questioned established thought. That has been Catalan upper middle-class hypocrisy and emotional paralysis (Goya winner “Three Days With the Family”), the comic patriarchy of paternal narcissism (series “Matar al Padre”) and the superiority of Scandinavian social models (“This Is Not Sweden”), Variety has written.

Her latest film, “Salve María,” which won a Locarno Special Mention in 2024, took a beg-to-differ view on maternity, questioning what still remains a taboo: whether all women are cut out for motherhood.

María Zamora and Elastica Films

Zamora, whose productions also include 2023 San Sebastián Golden Shell winner “The Rye Horn” and Cannes Directors’ Fortnight winner “Creatura,” won Spain’s National Cinematography Award for championing a new generation of Spanish auteurs, often women, driving their impact on the international film scene and helping them make on occasions a remarkable impact in domestic Spanish distribution.

article_text:
EXCLUSIVE: Janus Films has acquired all rights in North America and the UK/Ireland to Alfonso Cuarón’s classic fourth feature , Y Tu Mamá También , which has been restored in 4K to mark the 25th anniversary of its premiere.

The new 4K print will be released theatrically in the summer of 2027.

Y Tu Mamá También launched at the Venice Film Festival in 2001, where it won the Best Screenplay Award. The following year, it was nominated for the Best Screenplay Oscar, the Golden Globe for Best Motion Picture – Non-English Language, and the BAFTA for Best Original Screenplay and Best Film Not in the English Language.

Related Stories

Amy Madigan Joins 'Ascent' TV Series At Paramount+

Stoic To Launch AFM Sales On Holiday Comedy 'Unbearable Christmas' With Alex Moffat, Julia Stiles, David Cross

The film follows a pair of horny Mexico City teenagers (played by Gael García Bernal and Diego Luna), who, after their girlfriends jet off to Italy for the summer, become bewitched by an older Spanish woman (Maribel Verdú) they meet at a wedding. When she agrees to accompany them on a trip to a faraway beach, the three form an increasingly intense and sensual alliance that ultimately strips them both physically and emotionally bare.

Watch on Deadline

The title launched Bernal and Luna’s international careers along with Emmanuel “Chivo” Lubezki, who lensed the film, and, of course, Cuarón, who went on to win Academy Awards for Best Director ( Roma ), Best Editing ( Gravity ), Best Cinematography ( Roma ), and Best Foreign Language Film ( Roma )

“Y Tu Mamá También remains very close to me, and it means a great deal to see it return to theaters 25 years later,” Cuarón said in a statement. “I’m especially excited to share the film with a new generation, while longtime viewers can experience it again in a new 4K restoration. I’m grateful to Janus Films for making that possible.”

The deal was negotiated between Janus Films and WME on behalf of the filmmakers.

article_text:
Attraversare la traiettoria di Guido Guidi (Cesena, 1941) significa misurarsi con una delle discipline visive più rigorose e radicali del secondo Novecento italiano: un percorso che, prima ancora di esaurirsi nella pubblicazione o nell’esposizione museale, trova una delle sue matrici elettive negli spazi e nei laboratori dell’Università Iuav di Venezia. Qui Guidi è stato dapprima studente (iscrivendosi alla fine degli anni Cinquanta e seguendo gli insegnamenti di figure del calibro di Carlo Scarpa, Bruno Munari, Luigi Veronesi e Italo Zannier), poi tecnico di laboratorio e infine docente, dal 2001 al 2014. È proprio questo svelamento del retroterra accademico e umano che la mostra Guido Guidi. 101 fotografie , allestita al Magazzino 6 nell’ambito del Centenario dell’ateneo IUAV, sceglie di mettere a fuoco.

Lontano da ogni intento celebrativo o agiografico, il percorso curatoriale, firmato da Stefano Munarin, Michele Buda, Antonello Frongia e Andrea Pertoldeo , organizza una rigorosa selezione di centouno immagini in quattro sequenze tematiche: In Veneto , Ina-Casa , I Maestri e I Magazzini . La partizione restituisce la continuità di uno sguardo che non subisce mai la realtà attraverso filtri estetizzanti o distanze ironiche. Come lo stesso autore ha avuto modo di ribadire, la fotografia si configura piuttosto come un «atto devoto, preghiera»: un’immersione totale in ciò che viene ripreso, dove l’identificazione con l’oggetto esclude a priori qualsiasi giudizio di superiorità o distacco formale.

Le sezioni espositive documentano il modo in cui il confronto con l’ateneo, e in particolare con il dipartimento di urbanistica e i dialoghi con studiosi come Paolo Costantini e lo stesso Zannier, abbia orientato la lente di Guidi verso le trasformazioni silenziose del territorio contemporaneo. Dalle esplorazioni sistematiche dei quartieri Ina-Casa alle geometrie feriali della provincia veneta, fino ai residui industriali di Porto Marghera e alle tracce dei viaggi nei paesi dell’Est Europa, l’obiettivo si sofferma su ciò che i codici visivi tradizionali tendono a scartare: i margini e la densità dell’ordinario costituiscono il vero fuclro dell’interesse visvo di Guidi.

Ad arricchire questa ricognizione contribuisce una preziosa sezione documentaria che svela il metodo di lavoro dell’artista: tutta una serie di taccuini, appunti di studio, disegni, libri d’artista e la sequenza parziale di Preganziol affiancano le fotografie, evidenziando così come la costruzione della sequenza e del volume stampato rappresenti per Guidi un autonomo campo di ricerca teorica.

Chiude il percorso il video-documentario Da Guido , realizzato dal videoartista Alessandro Toscano , che restituisce il clima di studio e la pratica quotidiana nello studio dell’autore. Presentata con finalità didattiche ma sorretta da un impianto critico di alto livello, la mostra restituisce così la consistenza di uno sguardo che continua a insegnarci come guardare il mondo senza pretendere di dominarlo.

article_text:
チケットは160万円から！ BLACKPINKのロゼ、LAの美術館ガラで初パフォーマンスへ

BLACKPINKのロゼが、11月7日に ロサンゼルス・カウンティ美術館（LACMA） で開催される「アート＋フィルム・ガラ」に出演する。今年は、画家のヴィヤ・セルミンスと、 映画 『デューン』などを手がけた監督の映画監督のドゥニ・ヴィルヌーヴが表彰される。

K-POPグループ、BLACKPINKのロゼが、11月7日に ロサンゼルス・カウンティ美術館（LACMA） で開催される「アート＋フィルム・ガラ」でパフォーマンスを披露する。

今年で15回目を迎える同イベントでは、自然界を緻密に描写した作品で知られるラトビア系アメリカ人アーティストのヴィヤ・セルミンスと、 映画 『デューン』や『メッセージ』などの SF作品 で知られる映画監督のドゥニ・ヴィルヌーヴを表彰する。今年も グッチ がプレゼンティング・スポンサーを務め、俳優の レオナルド・ディカプリオ とLACMAの理事 エヴァ・チョウ が共同議長を務める。

チョウは声明で、「LACMAのアート＋フィルム・ガラは、創造性を体現する人々と、世界中のあらゆる表現分野のつながりを称える場です。世界的なポップスターであるロゼは、比類ない才能とスタイルで、この夜の祝祭をさらに盛り上げてくれるでしょう」と期待を込めた。

タイトルの通り、同ガラは毎年、文化の発展に貢献したアーティストと映画監督の2名を表彰している。初開催となった2011年版でジョン・バルデッサリとクリント・イーストウッドが称えられて以来、 ロサンゼルス のアートシーンにおける恒例行事の1つとなっている。2025年の開催では650万ドル（約10億2800万円）を調達し、前年の640万ドル（約10億1200万円）をわずかに上回った。

これまでにも、同ガラには数々の著名ミュージシャンが出演してきた。2025年は ドージャ・キャット 、2017年はアニー・レノックスがパフォーマンスを披露し、2024年にはチャーリーXCXに加えてトロイ・シヴァンがサプライズ出演を果たした。ロゼも2022年と2023年に同ガラに出席しているが、パフォーマーとして参加するのは今回が初めてとなる。

BLACKPINKのメンバーとして世界的な成功を収めるロゼは、ソロアーティストとしても活躍している。初のソロアルバム『rosie』は、累計ストリーミング再生回数が100億回を超えた。ブルーノ・マーズとのコラボレーション曲「APT.」は世界的なヒットとなり、グラミー賞で3部門にノミネートされている。

「アート＋フィルム・ガラ」のチケットは、1万ドル（約160万円）から。（翻訳：編集部）

Quello del Po attraversava confini fino a meno di due secoli fa. Il Ticino separava due sistemi territoriali diversi, fondati su differenti rapporti tra acqua, spazio e città: c’erano un bacino piemontese e uno lombardo-veneto. Nicolò degl’Incerti Tocci", "credit": "Exibart"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Attualità di Emigranti, del polacco Slawomir Mrożek"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Debutta, con la regia di Leo Muscato e con Valerio Santoro e Claudio Casadio , Emigranti del drammaturgo polacco Slawomir Mrożek (dal 30 ottobre e 1° novembre, al Teatro Diego Fabbri di Forlì). Il testo – scritto nel 1974 – è, ancora oggi o oggi ancora di più, di grande attualità, nella sua indagine sulle condizioni di estraneità e alienazione di chi, per necessità o scelta, vive in paese straniero."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "I due protagonisti – un intellettuale e un operaio –, nella notte del 31 dicembre e nel claustrofobico seminterrato che condividono, si trovano a confrontarsi sulle loro aspirazioni, desideri, umiliazioni e ideali, in un susseguirsi di schermaglie, sospetti, incomprensioni e situazioni paradossali. article_text:
In Scena è la rubrica dedicata agli spettacoli dal vivo in programmazione sui palchi di tutta Italia: ecco la nostra selezione della settimana, dal 26 ottobre all’1 novembre.

Danza e teatro

Goecke, Robbins, Bausch, trittico contemporaneo all’Opera di Roma

Tre grandi protagonisti della coreografia mondiale, tre linguaggi unici e un percorso musicale fra Debussy e Stravinskij. Il Teatro dell’Opera di Roma ospita Goecke / Robbins / Bausch ( all 27 ottobre all’8 novembre), omaggio all’eredità dell’impresario russo Sergej Djagilev , fondatore dei Ballets Russes, con tre titoli che hanno segnato la storia dei Ballets Russes e dello stesso Costanzi, che ne ha ospitato negli anni diverse rappresentazioni.

Sono le riletture di tre grandi coreografi: Afternoon of a Faun di Jerome Robbins , Petruschka firmato da Marco Goecke e Le Sacre du printemps di Pina Bausch con la coreografia originale ripresa da Clémentine Deluy , Jorge Puerta Armenta insieme a Eleonora Abbagnato e Damiano Ottavio Bigi . Protagonisti le Étoiles, i Primi Ballerini, i Solisti e il Corpo di Ballo del Teatro dell’Opera di Roma, insieme all’Orchestra del lirico capitolino diretta da Andrew Litton .

Incendi, una storia familiare, il dramma di un paese

Un incendio che non solo distrugge, ma illumina il mondo che brucia tra odio, guerre e violenza. Una vicenda personale, una storia familiare, il dramma di un paese in guerra civile che diventa una tragedia contemporanea e affonda le sue radici nel mito: Incendi di Wajdi Mouawad , porta la firma del regista Marco Lorenzi .

Nell’opera di Mouawad, Tragico e Storico sono categorie che convivono. La Storia dell’umanità si tinge del sangue versato in passato, le guerre di ieri scatenano i bombardamenti che annientano il presente, germe di future atrocità belliche ancora da scrivere.

Qui è una donna, Nawal, ad attraversare il destino, a subirlo e insieme a cercare di trasformarlo. La sua storia non è solo individuale, è una linea che attraversa le generazioni. Una genealogia femminile in cui il dolore, il silenzio e la rabbia si trasmettono come un’eredità invisibile. Ma è anche qualcosa di più: è il tentativo di interrompere una catena fatta di odio, di silenzi, di eredità non dette.

“Incendi”, di Wajdi Mouawad, traduzione Monica Capuani, regia Marco Lorenzi, con Frédérique Loliée, Filippo Dini, Barbara Mazzi, Elio D’Alessandro, Aleksandar Cvjetković, Gennaro Di Biase, Giovanni Drago, Emilia Piz, Sara Verteramo; scene e regia video Daniele Spanò, costumi Alessio Rosati, luci Umberto Camponeschi, suono Massimiliano Bressan. Produzione Teatro Stabile del Veneto – Teatro Nazionale, prima nazionale, Teatro Verdi Padova, dal 27 ottobre al 3 novembre; al Teatro Del Monaco di Treviso, dal 5 all’8, Teatro Goldoni di Venezia, dal 12 al 15, e in tournée

Che dolore terribile è l’amore

Nel suo romanzo Non dico addio , Han Kang , la scrittrice Premio Nobel, affronta una delle pagine più buie del recente passato della Corea del Sud: la sanguinosa repressione della rivolta di Jeju, nel 1948. È la storia di due amiche, Gyeong-ha e In-seon, e della madre di una di loro, unite dal desiderio di non dimenticare, di non dire addio a chi ci ha lasciato tragicamente. Attraverso la ricerca di una persona cara durata tutta una vita, la vicenda esplora i modi in cui la natura brutale e totalizzante della violenza appiattisce ogni individualità, ma anche come una tenace speranza riesca a salvare una singola persona caduta nel dimenticatoio, toccando e illuminando le vite di altre vittime.

L’attrice Daria Deflorian nello spettacolo Che dolore terribile è l’amore , percorre e interroga questo testo perturbante, condividendo con Han Kang il rifiuto di ridurre le tragedie ai meri nomi delle città e al numero dei morti.

“Che dolore terribile è l’amore”, a partire da Non dico addio di Han Kang, drammaturgia e regia Daria Deflorian con Daria Deflorian, Maria Grazia Mandruzzato, Monica Piseddu, dramaturg Eric Vautrin, scene e aiuto regia Andrea Pizzalis, luci Giulia Pastore, suono Emanuele Pontecorvo, costumi Ettore Lombardi. una produzione INDEX. A Milano, Teatro Studio Melato, dal 30 ottobre all’8 novembre.

Confessioni e anatemi di Caryl Churchill

Nel testo Escaped Alone di Caryl Churchill ci sono tre amiche di lunga data, Sally, Vi e Lena, che accolgono nel loro cerchio la nuova arrivata, la Signora Jarrett. Insieme danno vita a un chiacchiericcio pomeridiano fitto, istintivo e ricco di cambi d’umore, in cui i pensieri si intrecciano senza mai interrompersi davvero. A rompere questa quiete borghese sono i soliloqui della Signora Jarrett: confessioni e anatemi rivolti direttamente al pubblico che trasformano la quotidianità delle protagoniste in un affresco minaccioso del nostro presente. Così, mentre le quattro donne affrontano il declino della vecchiaia, si annuncia sullo sfondo il possibile, inquietante tramonto dell’intera umanità.

“Escaped Alone”, di Caryl Churchill, traduzione Monica Capuani, un progetto di lacasadargilla, regia Lisa Ferlazzo Natoli e Alessandro Ferroni, dramaturg Margherita Mauro, con Caterina Carpio, Tania Garribba, Arianna Gaudio, Alice Palazzi. produzione Piccolo Teatro di Milano – Teatro d’Europa, Teatro di Roma – Teatro Nazionale. A Roma, Teatro Valle, fino al 1° novembre; a Modena, Teatro delle Passioni, dal 5 all’8 novembre; a Torino, Teatro Carignano, dal 10 al 15.

L’orologio americano di Arthur Miller

Il regista Elio De Capitani sceglie ancora Arthur Miller per parlarci di noi e di oggi, spostando l’attenzione dai suoi capolavori più noti al suo testo più innovativo e poco noto in Italia. L’orologio americano , composto nel 1980, aspira a un’originale forma di teatro totale, che risente della lezione di Brecht – sia quello espressionista dei primi drammi che agli sviluppi successivi del teatro epico – per portarla verso esiti totalmente inediti, ispirandosi a un genere teatrale tipicamente americano, il vaudeville.

Miller ci porta nel pieno della Grande Depressione e della crisi che investe l’America nel 1929. Rispetto ai testi precedenti, qui allarga il campo del suo racconto: il ring delle azioni non è circoscritto alla famiglia americana, ma guarda all’intero paese. Il grande sviluppo corale mette alla prova la giovane Compagnia dell’Accademia, di attori e attrici che hanno appena concluso il percorso di studi all’Accademia Nazionale d’Arte Drammatica “Silvio d’Amico”.

La Medium, mentalismo femminista

La Medium – di e con Marta Cuscunà – racconta la storia vera di Hersilie Rouy , nata a Milano e figlia dell’illusionista ottocentesco Charles Rouy , famoso per il numero de “La Donna Invisibile”. Molti numeri che hanno fatto la storia della magia ricalcano un copione sessista: uomini che per dare prova del loro potere, usano come strumento il corpo di una donna che, intera o a pezzi, sparisce.

Lo spettacolo (al Festival Romaeuropa, Teatro Vascello, il 28 e 29 ottobre) si ispira a Incantagioni di Mariano Tomatis e cerca di offrire a quelle donne invisibili, che troppe volte sono state fatte sparire, nuovi corpi in cui materializzarsi. Lo spettacolo rievoca l’immaginario dei salotti esoterici europei tra Ottocento e Novecento, dove si tenevano spettacolari sedute spiritiche le cui protagoniste erano donne-medium che per le loro particolari capacità furono studiate e analizzate fin nella loro intimità.

Il Po raccontato da Marco Paolini

Marco Paolini torna al Piccolo di Milano con le prime due tappe di un trittico teatrale, scritto con Giulio Boccaletti , nell’ambito del progetto corale Atlante delle Rive . Dopo Bestiario idrico, ora in prima assoluta, Dov’è il Po? ( dal 27 ottobre al 1° novembre).

«I fiumi a volte attraversano i confini, ma non li rispettano – scrive Paolini -. Ragionano per bacini idrografici. La geografia fisica disegna i rilievi, ma le montagne sono riconoscibili per chiunque, mentre è più difficile per noi riconoscere il bacino. Quello del Po attraversava confini fino a meno di due secoli fa. Il Ticino separava due sistemi territoriali diversi, fondati su differenti rapporti tra acqua, spazio e città: c’erano un bacino piemontese e uno lombardo-veneto. Cominciamo raccontando la storia del Po “di sopra”, immaginando di poter raccontare il resto nel prossimo spettacolo».

Uscita di emergenza, ovvero la precarietà dell’esistenza umana

Scritta nel 1978, Uscita di emergenza , di Manlio Santanelli , è una delle opere più rappresentative e tra i testi più amati e rappresentati del drammaturgo napoletano. A riproporla in scena è il regista Alfio Scuderi . Al centro della vicenda ci sono temi ricorrenti nella drammaturgia dell’autore: la solitudine, l’incomunicabilità tra gli individui e la precarietà dell’esistenza umana.

La commedia racconta l’incontro di due uomini che si ritrovano a condividere un angusto spazio abitativo, un luogo precario, segnato dalla minaccia di crolli a causa del terremoto che incombe su tutto e scandisce il passare del tempo. Da questa precarietà prende vita un confronto umano a tratti anche violento, intenso, in cui ironia e dramma si intrecciano, dando voce alla fragilità dell’esistenza e alla difficoltà di comunicare del genere umano.

“ Uscita di emergenza”, di Manlio Santanelli con Vincenzo Ferrera e Nando Paone, musiche Roy Paci, scene Enzo Venezia, costumi Roberta Mattera, luci Luigi Biondi e Omar Scala. Produzione Teatro di Napoli – Teatro Nazionale. A Napoli, Teatro San Ferdinando, dal 29 ottobre all’8 novembre.

Giornate d’Autore al Teatro Due di Parma

Dalla Siria a Hong Kong, dalla Germania alla Turchia, passando per Austria e Francia: le Giornate d’Autore (ideazione Fondazione Teatro Due di Parma, nell’ambito di Reggio Parma Festival , al Teatro Due, dal 28 al 31 ottobre,) riuniscono voci provenienti da geografie, culture e percorsi profondamente diversi, restituendo la ricchezza e la complessità della drammaturgia contemporanea internazionale.

Storie e sguardi differenti si confrontano con alcune delle questioni più urgenti del presente, dalla guerra alla tecnologia, dall’identità alle trasformazioni sociali. Ai protagonisti Liwaa Yazji, Dea Loher, Marion Siéfert, Pat To Yan, Mazlum Nergiz , Lilly Busch, Ian de Toffoli sarà dedicata una giornata con incontri e focus attraverso una conversazione con lettura di alcuni loro lavori inediti in Italia, appositamente tradotti.

Riappropriarsi della propria identità e libertà

Per la rassegna Fuorimargine , lo spettacolo di Masako Matsushita Un/Dress me now (EXMA, Cagliari il 30 e 31 ottobre) rielabora la ricerca sul significato politico dei tessuti e del corpo, affrontando le dinamiche di potere e gli stereotipi che condizionano la rappresentazione del femminile nella società contemporanea. Attraverso il gesto di vestirsi e spogliarsi, il lavoro esplora la possibilità di riappropriarsi della propria identità e libertà, oltre le narrazioni commerciali e strumentali. In questa nuova versione, il danzatore Aurelio Di Virgilio decostruisce il potere dell’immagine, restituendo al corpo maschile nudo consapevolezza, umanità e bellezza.

Alda Merini. All’amore non si resiste

Non è stata solo una poetessa. Alda Merini è stata un corpo che ha avuto bisogno di toccare e di essere toccato in un luogo, il manicomio, dove il contatto era proibito. Una donna rinchiusa per anni in manicomio perché dicevano fosse folle. In verità aveva fame. Fame d’amore. Parte da quella mancanza lo spettacolo Alda Merini. All’amore non si resiste della coreografa Monica Casadei, una creazione per 9 performer della Compagnia Artemis Danza e un’attrice (a Milano, Teatro Menotti, il 26 e 27 ottobre; a Parma, Teatro al Parco, il 28).

In scena non c’è la follia come spettacolo ma il bisogno radicale che Alda ci ha insegnato: il corpo ha bisogno di un altro un altro corpo. Di un contatto. Senza, si muore. La danza è claustrofobia e poi è liberazione. È una camicia di forza che diventa abito da sposa. È un gesto che cerca un altro gesto. È caduta e risalita. Sandra Soncini , sulle musiche originali di Fabio Fiandrini , dà voce alle parole di Alessandro Gallo e lascia che le attraversino il corpo.

A cena con Macbeth

In A cena con Macbeth , Emanuele Conte torna a confrontarsi con la tragedia shakesperiana in un nuovo adattamento che ne vuole restituire la sostanza più pura e brutale. Pur mantenendo i temi centrali della tragedia, mette al centro il rapporto d’amore tra Macbeth e Lady Macbeth, esplorando e rivelando la radice più intima e umana – spesso trascurata dalla critica tradizionale – della loro unione tanto viscerale e simbiotica. Due personaggi e il loro dramma, due metà di uno stesso essere che si scambiano la pelle, incarnando ora l’ambizione pura e spietata, ora la coscienza lacerata e paralizzata dal terrore.

Lo spettacolo si consuma attorno alla tavola di un banchetto, una cena macabra e grottesca in uno spazio opprimente che cambia forma di continuo, da luogo reale, ad altare, a labirinto dell’anima.

“A cena con Macbeth”, drammaturgia e regia Emanuele Conte, con Ludovica Baiardi, Raffaele Barca, Alessandro Bergallo, Pietro Fabbri, Marco Rivolta, Graziano Sirressi, Matteo Traverso, Graziano Sirressi, Pietro Fabbri, Marco Rivolta; costumi Daniela De Blasio, disegno luci Matteo Selis. Produzione Fondazione Luzzati Teatro della Tosse, a Milano, Teatro Fontana, dal 28 al 30 ottobre.

Al via Danae Festival

Ad aprire il 27 e 28 ottobre, al Teatro Out Off di Milano, la XXVIII edizione di Danae Festival è Silvia Gribaudi con Suspended Chorus che focalizza la propria ricerca sull’impatto sociale del corpo, mettendo al centro la comicità e la relazione con il pubblico.

Il 30, Operabianco in Trickster , col performer Luca Piomponi : un viaggio tra danza, cinema, pittura e clownerie, attraverso le citazioni da Francis Bacon a Buster Keaton . Il corpo è anche al centro del lavoro di Lucia Guarino , Contengo Moltitudini, studio al di qua e al di là della figura di Pulcinella (31 ottobre, Fabbrica del Vapore); Miranda Secondari, coreografa e performer, con Gherminella (1 novembre, Teatro Out Off) firma una performance assieme a Nicola Ratti ; la danzatrice Silvia Mai (1 novembre, Fabbrica del Vapore), che in seguito alla sua esperienza da pastora, presenta Oikos affiancata in scena da un cane, Eco, e in cui sonda il confine tra animalità e umanità. Il 4 novembre Nicolò Porcelluzzi con Flussi d’amore tra narrazione, cinema e performance musicale.

Il programma completo sul sito danaefestival.com .

Lady Grey. Con le luci sempre più fioche

Il drammaturgo americano Will Eno , finalista al Premio Pulitzer nel 2005, costruisce un testo, Lady Grey. Con le luci sempre più fioche , il secondo di una sua trilogia sull’esistenza e sull’identità femminile, che tenta un percorso pericoloso nelle profondità dell’animo umano (al Teatro Filodrammatici di Milano, dal 27 ottobre al 1° novembre, produzione Centro Teatrale MaMiMò, con Alice Giroldini, regia Marco Maccieri).

La maestra ha dato un nuovo compito alla classe, il “Mostra e Dimostra”: portare a scuola qualcosa di importante e rappresentativo di sé — un oggetto, un animale domestico, una foto — e parlarne. La Bambina prende il compito alla lettera e non sa che cosa portare: qual è l’oggetto che più di tutti può rappresentarla e raccontare la sua storia? In questa ricerca arriva a chiedersi quale sia la sua identità e dove sia collocata.

Attualità di Emigranti, del polacco Slawomir Mrożek

Debutta, con la regia di Leo Muscato e con Valerio Santoro e Claudio Casadio , Emigranti del drammaturgo polacco Slawomir Mrożek (dal 30 ottobre e 1° novembre, al Teatro Diego Fabbri di Forlì). Il testo – scritto nel 1974 – è, ancora oggi o oggi ancora di più, di grande attualità, nella sua indagine sulle condizioni di estraneità e alienazione di chi, per necessità o scelta, vive in paese straniero.

I due protagonisti – un intellettuale e un operaio –, nella notte del 31 dicembre e nel claustrofobico seminterrato che condividono, si trovano a confrontarsi sulle loro aspirazioni, desideri, umiliazioni e ideali, in un susseguirsi di schermaglie, sospetti, incomprensioni e situazioni paradossali. Senza cronachismi o finti pietismi, è un testo che, con l’arte della poesia, rappresenta l’universale. Lo spettacolo è una co-produzione Teatro Biondo Palermo, Accademia Perduta/Romagna Teatri e Teatri Stabili di Friuli Venezia Giulia, Catania e Abruzzo. In tournée.

Nello street food del sudcoreano Jaha Koo

Vincitore quest’anno dell’International Ibsen Award, il più prestigioso riconoscimento mondiale per il teatro, arriva per la prima volta a Milano per FOG, il 28 e 29 ottobre, l’autore, compositore e performer sudcoreano Jaha Koo . Pièce rivelazione dell’artista, Haribo Kimchi è un racconto onirico e sorprendente ambientato in un pojangmacha (tipico chiosco notturno di street food), che coinvolge tutti i sensi per dar vita a una riflessione profonda sull’identità e sull’assimilazione culturale. Un racconto capace di parlare in maniera straordinaria a tutti coloro che vivono o si sono trovati a vivere lontani dalla propria cultura.

YoY Performing Arts, Ricordarsi il futuro

Non sappiamo quando comincia il futuro. Forse è già qui, nascosto in qualcosa che non abbiamo imparato a riconoscere. Immaginarlo significa ripercorrere le tracce del passato e provare a intravedere ciò che ancora non esiste: una possibilità che possiamo ancora inventare, insieme.

Ti ricordi il futuro? della coppia di coreografi e performer Emma Zani e Roberto Doveri di YoY Performing Arts (a Brescia, Teatro Grande, il 28 ottobre) prende ispirazione dall’opera di Valerio Berruti C’è troppa luce per non credere nella luce (Belgrado 2011), che ritrae un gruppo di bambini, raccolti in cerchio, nell’attesa di un ritorno alla vita. Da questa immagine prende forma una riflessione sul futuro e l’utopia, tra speranze, ideali e paure, per interrogarci su ciò che ancora non conosciamo e mantenere viva la possibilità di ciò che avverrà.

松坂桃李さんの主演で、来年１月10日に放送開始の大河ドラマ「逆賊の幕臣」。キービジュアルが発表されました。また音楽は 大間々 昂 さんが担当します。

＜題字・キービジュアル＞ アートディレクター 木谷 友亮（きたに・ゆうすけ）さん

【題字について】 小栗が日常的に書き残していた特徴的な手書きの線を、タイトルデザインに取り入れました。枠に収まる必要がある役人としての立場を表現しました。また、明朝体を精緻に手書きすることで、役人としての小栗の真面目さや実直さを表現しています。一方、小栗を知るほどに本人の内面にある強さ・野性味を感じることが多く、それが彼の最期につながったのではないかと思いました。その一面を題字に取り入れるために、整然とした造形にあえて逸脱を加えました。それまで几帳面に描かれていた文字が最後の一画のみ勢いのある筆の線に変わっています。几帳面に整えられた造形と、そこから生まれる逸脱。その対比によって、小栗の人物像と、時代の枠を越えようとする意志を表現したタイトルデザインです。 【キービジュアルについて】 劇中には、小栗が平伏する、地面にしゃがんで文字を書くといった幕臣としての象徴的な場面があります。これらに共通する「下を向いた小栗」を、地面に近い位置から見上げるローアングルで撮影しメインビジュアルにしました。こめかみに浮かぶ血管などの身体的なディテールも再現し、小栗の内に秘めた緊張感やエネルギーを際立たせています。 【プロフィール】 1976年千葉県生まれ。株式会社カイブツ アートディレクター。工業高校で手やすりで金属を削りつづけたのち、企業のグラフィック広告やプロモーションイベントの企画やデザインを手がける道に進む。 主な仕事にNetflix『ダウンタイム』『幽☆遊☆白書』、『井上尚弥vs中谷潤人』『kishiboy ラグビーのルール超初級編』など。

＜キービジュアル＞ フォトグラファー 高梨 遼平（たかなし・りょうへい）さん

【プロフィール】 1984年生まれ。2008年多摩美術大学グラフィックデザイン学科卒業。 2025年より同大学非常勤講師。 画家である父の影響で絵を描きはじめ、写真へと至る。 広告写真を中心に活動しながら、絵画から着想を得た「重層性を帯びた写真表現」を追求。 徹底したライティングとアングル検証を重ねることを制作の信条としている。 NY ADC金賞、Cannes Lions金賞、ADFESTグランプリなど受賞多数。

●人物デザイン監修 柘植 伊佐夫（つげ・いさお）さん

【コメント】 素晴らしいキャストをはじめ、制作統括の勝田夏子さん、チーフ演出の西村武五郎監督、これまでもご一緒してきたスタッフや、新たにチームを組むメンバーの皆さんと、この『逆賊の幕臣』をともに制作できることを、とても嬉しく思います。本作は、私にとりまして四作目の大河ドラマとなり、2010年の『龍馬伝』以来、ふたたび幕末を舞台とする作品に携わることでも、初心に立ち返る思いです。この作品のビジュアルコンセプトは「渋みの華」としました。「目立たずとも、内からわき立つ華がある」。そんな人物たちの姿を、一人ひとり、丁寧に生み出せるよう精進いたします。視聴者の皆様に一年間、楽しんでいただき、応援していただければ幸いです。 【プロフィール】 人物デザイナーとして、衣裳、ヘアメイク、持ち道具を統合し、登場人物の存在をトータルで設計する。2010年の大河ドラマ『龍馬伝』で、大河ドラマ史上初となる「人物デザイン監修」を企画、担当。人物造形の新しい方法を開拓する。 主な作品に、映画『シン・ゴジラ』『翔んで埼玉』『はたらく細胞』『10DANCE』、ドラマ『ガス人間』、舞台『エヴァンゲリオン・ビヨンド』『アンバース』『リア王』など。 NHKでは、大河ドラマ『龍馬伝』『平清盛』『どうする家康』のほか、『精霊の守り人』『ストレンジャー～上海の芥川龍之介～』『岸辺露伴は動かない』『魯山人のかまど』などを担当。 「人物デザインの開拓」により、第30回毎日ファッション大賞・鯨岡阿美子賞を受賞。

●音楽 大間々 昂（おおまま・たかし）さん

【コメント】 学生の頃、恩師の渡辺俊幸先生に『利家とまつ』のメインテーマの楽譜を見せて頂きながら、いつか自分も大河ドラマをやってみたい。と話していたのを覚えています。それから十数年が経ち、この度『逆賊の幕臣』の音楽を担当させて頂くことがとても感慨深く、光栄です。 小栗忠順は、敵勢力からも後世に残るべき偉人であったと惜しまれながら斬首されました。対立や枠組み、国境を超え、日本の未来の為に彼が見た夢、今の私たちに残した偉業、歴史に翻弄されながらどのように最期を迎えたのか。彼の人生に想いを馳せながら、現代とより地続きなイメージで没入感のある音楽を作りたいと思いました。NHK交響楽団の皆様との共演は私にとって大きな挑戦です。指揮の広上先生はじめ、全ての音楽制作を支えてくれた仲間、ミュージシャン、クリエイターの皆様に感謝いたします。 【プロフィール】 1988年生まれ、東京都出身。映画『正体』で日本アカデミー賞優秀音楽賞を受賞。主な作品に、映画では『汝、星のごとく』『最後まで行く』『アキラとあきら』『死刑にいたる病』『浅草キッド』『樹海村』『愚行録』。ドラマでは『ガス人間』『イクサガミ』『ガンニバル』シーズン２や『リブート』『マイファミリー』。アニメでは『機動戦士ガンダム 水星の魔女』『アオのハコ』『スター・ウォーズ：ビジョンズ 「ユコの宝物」』。NHKの作品では、NHKスペシャル『人類誕生』『スペース・スペクタクル』『コントレール〜罪と恋〜』など。 ＜テーマ曲指揮＞ 広上 淳一 ＜テーマ曲演奏＞ NHK交響楽団 ＜オーケストレーション＞ マーク・グラハム ＜テーマ曲ミキシング＞ エヴァ・ライスタッド
